the Sidebar is only rendered when apps.length>0 || explorer.root!==null (line ~516), so a home-rooted explorer also needs a non-null home path to appear on a fresh install.
the shared Dialog has no Escape handler today; focus goes to the first action on mount, and no backdrop click closes it.
appButton(states) returns "stop" if any terminal isUp, else "start" (lines 135-137); AppHeader disables Start when app.terminals.length===0.
the on-screen Start all / Stop all button is the reference F5 must mirror; it uses appButton(states) and onStartAll/onStopAll.
the palette and the Help/Confirm dialogs all import the shared Dialog, so moving Dialog moves them; Help text line ~271 still advertises F5 refresh.
the explorer is rendered through the existing explorer prop in the expanded pane (line ~112), so R13 needs no Sidebar change.
F5 now maps to toggleApp for every modifier; there is no refresh shortcut id in APP_SHORTCUTS.
toggleAppNow is a ref refreshed each render; the one key listener reads it so F5 sees the live view/app/state.
startAll touches the app; stopAll does not, and F5 mirrors the on-screen button including the no-terminals no-op.
wraps ZestResponsiveLayout with sidePane.visible; omitting onClose keeps the overlay non-dismissing and avoids the package's unnamed x.
its own named Close button plus a document Escape listener call the caller's cancel action; no onClose means no close path.
last action is the cancel action; close label is "Close <title>", the dialog keeps role=dialog aria-label=<title> and first-action focus.
.finder is width:100%/min-width:0; .cardTitle uses overflow-wrap:anywhere.
jattac.libs.web.zest-responsive-layout ^2.8.0; its ESM bundle injects its stylesheet, no CSS import needed.
renders inside SidePane (title and closeLabel Switch branch); keeps filter focus, sections, picking and Escape.
UpdateDialog builds on the shared Dialog, so it is already a side pane; busy (empty actions) keeps no close path.
package header renders the title and only adds its unnamed x when onClose is set, so we omit onClose and use our own named Close.
home_folder() reads only USERPROFILE via std::env::var_os, no disk access, returns None when empty; explorer_home is a plain sync command.

explorer_list takes an arbitrary absolute path from the window and reads it on a blocking worker, capped at MAX_SCANNED 10k / MAX_RETURNED 1000; no path allowlist (accepted by the privacy/permissions coverage).
Escape is a document-level keydown listener added only when onClose is set; no onClose means no close path (used for the busy update dialog).
the pane close/Escape runs actions[actions.length - 1]; every existing Dialog last action is a non-destructive cancel (Cancel / Keep running / No, thanks / Close).
CSP unchanged by this revision: default-src 'self', no 'unsafe-eval', no remote scripts; capability stays core:default + dialog:allow-open for windows ["main"].
the palette renders its own `<div role="dialog">` (line 89), NOT the shared Dialog/SidePane; no test asserts it stays out of a side pane.
Dialog renders inside SidePane; the cancel action is the last action and the close control is named "Close <title>"; no actions means no close path.
toggleAppNow ref is reassigned each render (lines 375-378) and the single F5 listener reads it (line 158); F5 mirrors appButton/startAll/stopAll.
R7 coverage is only stylesheet-string assertions (.finder width 100%/min-width 0, .cardTitle overflow-wrap); no 360px render test.
R13 home/editor/misc root tests mock explorerApi.home and assert explorerApi.list is called with the home path.
renders ZestResponsiveLayout with NO ZestLayoutThemeProvider, so the package falls back to its light theme; the pane is white (hsla(0,0%,100%,.95)) even though the app default theme is dark.
DEFAULT_THEME_ID is tinkerdeck-dark (line 5); dark --text is #ece8dc and --muted #a0a4ab.
.dialog background is transparent and body uses color var(--muted), so dark-theme dialog text sits on the package's white pane (unreadable).
line 54 still lists F5 as refresh; docs/ui-tidy-up-plan.md lines 133/147/267 and CHANGELOG.md lines 10/81 still say F5 refreshes.
framer-motion ^14.14.0 with jattac.libs.web.zest-tabs ^0.5.0 (peer framer-motion ^10||^11||^12); no .npmrc, so plain npm install still ERESOLVE (pre-existing).
F5 repetition tests at lines 430 and 454 press twice (start-then-stop, and stop twice while starting); both pass and fail if a second start is issued.
no ZestLayoutThemeProvider, so the package defaults to its light pane (hsla(0,0%,100%,.95)) while the app default theme is dark; reviewer-raised, not a QA test gap.
on initial load it calls setSelectedAppId(view.config.apps[0].id), so `app` in App is non-null even in the home view; home/editor F5 no-op tests do exercise the view!=="app" guard.
the R8 exclusion test (lines 49-54) asserts no element with class *ZestResponsiveLayout-module_sidePane exists and the palette dialog has no such ancestor.
the package pane element carries class ZestResponsiveLayout-module_sidePane and its content is rendered inside that element.
passes inline style to the package sidePane (background/color/zest vars from app theme vars) so the pane follows the app theme instead of the package default light theme.
line 54 ("**F5** refresh") is the only stale F5-refresh hint in the user-facing README (R6).
lines 109, 133, 147, 150, 218 and 267 still describe F5 as the Refresh shortcut; all need updating for R6.
line 10 (2.1.0, current) and line 81 (1.2.0, historical) mention F5 refresh; only the current-version wording advertises present behaviour.
F5 maps to toggleApp and refresh has no key; all in-app F5-refresh hints/tests were already updated.
the package copies sidePane.style onto the pane element, so inline background var(--panel)/color var(--text)/--zest-pane-bg make every pane follow the app theme without ZestLayoutThemeProvider.
all tracked F5-refresh wording now describes Start all / Stop all; installer/output release notes are gitignored generated artifacts, not source.
explorer_list/explorer_drives/explorer_home are thin async shells over the blocking worker; every new file-operation command must be registered in src-tauri/src/lib.rs generate_handler.
Listing/Entry are camelCase; list_level caps at MAX_RETURNED 1000 rows and MAX_SCANNED 10000; HIDDEN_NAMES = node_modules/.git/target/dist; Entry.locked is always false in a listing.

Store.open_path reuses an existing entry by same_path, so explorer clicks already focus an open tab; Store.close sets binned_at for a dirty entry, so an unsaved tab goes to the editor bin instead of being discarded.
TerminalDef has no executable field today; `yes()` is the existing serde default-true helper to copy for a missing flag.

appButton(states) and rollup(states) take TermState[] only and have no TerminalDef, so filtering to executable terminals must happen at the call sites (AppHeader, HomeScreen, App) or these signatures change; AppHeader/HomeScreen are merged code needing characterization tests.
openPath calls editorApi.open (editor_open_any) and then onOpened; close(id) flushes then api.close, so re-pointing a tab on rename/move needs a new path-update command, not close+open.
revision 2 already maps every F5 variant to toggleApp and APP_SHORTCUTS has no refresh entry; R12 mainly needs the palette/app hints and tests confirmed.
palette Start all/Stop all entries show no shortcut; Refresh everything shows none; toggleAppNow guards view==="app"; explorerResetKey derives from view|selectedAppId|activePath.
the panel currently receives only root/source/resetKey/onOpenFile and has no create/rename/delete/move hooks, so R9 adds callbacks or a controller from App.
Dialog renders inside SidePane; first action gets focus, last action is the cancel path, and a dialog with no actions has no close path.
explorer commands run under core:default + dialog:allow-open; new app-registered fs commands need no new capability, and windows stay ["main"].
pickFolder exists for choosing a destination folder (used by EditPane) and can back an explicit Move action.
thin async commands over list_level/drives/home; new file ops belong here with spawn_blocking; EditorState is a separate managed Arc<EditorState>.
Store persists an index.json and *.buf snapshots; open_path/close/save are the existing tab bookkeeping; repoint and close_under must be added additively.
TerminalDef derives Default, so a new executable bool needs #[serde(default = "yes")] and a manual Default that keeps every old field identical but executable true.
appButton/rollup are pure helpers used by AppHeader, HomeScreen, Sidebar and App F5; add executable-aware wrappers instead of changing their bodies.
F5 already calls toggleAppNow and the palette refresh entry already has no shortcut; only the F5 key hint on Start/Stop is missing for R12.
no media queries today, so a mobile-first base plus a min-width desktop block is the whole R10 change.
rows are <button> elements, so per-row action buttons cannot be nested; use selection plus a header actions menu, inline name form, and drag/drop handlers.
reloadShown() rebuilds the root and every expanded level from the bounded cache; forgetUnder plus a per-folder reload is enough after a mutation.
typed wrappers only; add create/rename/move/delete functions here and mirror the new commands in the same file.
core:default plus dialog:allow-open; custom explorer commands need no new capability or permission.
tabs live in local state and quiet timers are keyed by doc id; resync must merge editor_list preserving loaded content and clear timers/latest for removed ids.
each terminal is a fieldset; the executable switch belongs beside Shell/Advanced and draft() must save the flag explicitly.
the last action is always the cancel action, and Escape/the pane close both run it.
Dialog already renders through the jattac side pane, so the delete confirmation can use Dialog directly from the explorer.
list_level/list_level_with, HIDDEN_NAMES, MAX_RETURNED and MAX_SCANNED are the browsing core; a new ops module can sit beside commands.rs.
Store has no repath method; same_path lowercases and unifies slashes, and buffers are keyed by entry id, so changing entry.path keeps unsaved text.
Store::close bins dirty entries and removes clean ones, but it does not flush a pending typing snapshot, so deleting a file must snapshot first.
Store::open_path reuses an entry by same_path and clears binned_at, so re-pointing must change entry.path/title, not create a new entry.
receives states only (App.tsx passes app.terminals.map), so App decides which states are executable.
props are root/source/resetKey/onOpenFile only; rows are buttons with no action or drag hooks.
the editor Store lives in its own managed EditorState (Arc<EditorState>), not AppState, so explorer file-op commands that re-point or close tabs must take State<Arc<EditorState>>.
Store keeps only entry metadata in memory; text is in .buf files written by snapshot(), and Store::close sets binned_at (dirty tabs go to the bin, not discarded).
TerminalDef derives Default today, so adding executable=true needs the derive replaced by a manual Default impl (serde default alone only covers missing JSON).
start_all spawns a thread over app.terminals in order; stop_all builds ids from app.terminals, so executable filtering belongs in both loops.
up() starts every app terminal then wait_until_ready()/report() iterate app.terminals again; both the start loop and the readiness loops need the executable filter.
Dialog is already a thin wrapper over SidePane (jattac) with first-action focus and last-action cancel; reuse it for the delete confirmation.
F5 is driven by matchShortcut -> toggleAppNow.current (a ref), which calls appButton over live states then L.actions.startAll/stopAll; F5 is preventDefault in every view.
palette refresh entry has no shortcut and is labeled "Refresh everything"; built-in palette Start all/Stop all entries currently have no key hint (R12 wants F5 where a hint is shown).
levels are cached per folder with MAX_CACHED_LEVELS=100 and refresh() reloads expanded folders plus the root, so post-op refresh can call it.
onOpenFile receives entry.path and App passes editor.openPath; Store::open_path reuses the existing entry by same_path, so no duplicate tab.

explorer_create(path,name,kind)->String; explorer_rename(path,name)/explorer_move(path,into)/explorer_delete(path)->ExplorerOp{path,repaths:[{id,path,title}],closed:[id]}.
Store::repath_prefix(old,new)->Vec<Entry> and close_prefix(item,now)->Vec<String> added; unsaved buffers follow the tab.

explorerApi.create/rename/move/remove wrap explorer_create/explorer_rename/explorer_move/explorer_delete; ExplorerOp={path,repaths,closed}.
create/rename/delete prompts on the shared Dialog; validateExplorerName mirrors the core's name checks.
useExplorerOps({explorer,editor}) owns prompt/busy/error, calls explorerApi then reloadFolder/forgetUnder; App must pass a memoised editor bridge to enable it without breaking FileRow memo.
reloadFolder(path) re-reads root via reloadToken or one expanded/loaded child; forgetUnder(path) drops cached levels and expansion under a path.
AppDef::executable_terminals() is the single R11 bulk filter (serde default true).
start_all and stop_all iterate app.executable_terminals(), not app.terminals.
EditorController exposes flushPending/applyRepaths/applyClosed/dirtyTitlesUnder; applyClosed assumes the core already closed+binned and only drops local tabs then refreshes the bin.
editorBridge is a useMemo of those four callbacks and is passed to ExplorerPanel as `editor`; F5 and AppHeader states filter with isExecutable; palette Start/Stop carry shortcutKeys("toggleApp").
TerminalDef.executable? plus isExecutable (false only when explicitly false); newTerminal sets executable true.
the card dot and the Start all / Stop all state follow only executable terminals (isExecutable); running consoles still offer Stop all.
R11 checks newTerminal().executable === true and isExecutable treats a missing flag as on.
appRollup filters terminals with isExecutable so the app status dot matches Start all / Stop all (R11).
each terminal fieldset has a labelled executable checkbox; draft() writes executable: t.executable !== false.
mobile-first base (width 100%, max-height 100dvh, place-items start stretch) and @media (min-width:640px) restores the desktop palette.
reads the CSS raw with node:fs + process.cwd(); Vitest css:false makes ?raw return the CSS-module proxy, not a string.
asserts 2.3.0; a version bump must also update package-lock.json and App.test.tsx (v2.3.0 in the footer).
start_all/stop_all filter via AppDef::executable_terminals() at :137 and :161; no test calls either command, terminal_executable.rs only exercises the helper.
r9_delete_uses_the_real_recycle_bin (:294) only asserts !exists(), so a permanent delete would also pass it.
delete_item (:409) delegates to delete_item_with(trash::delete); the injected tests bypass that production wrapper.
r9_a_move_between_drives_is_refused (:230) only calls same_volume(), not move_item.
rename/move apply repaths then reload the affected levels; delete flushes pending then applies closed tabs.
mobile base width 100%/100dvh, @media(min-width:640px) restores 12vh + min(560px,100%) + 60vh.
explorer_rename/move/delete mutate the fs first, then Store::repath_prefix/close_prefix; a persist failure after the fs change is unhandled.
`selected` is cleared only on [resetKey, root], so it stays stale after a rename/move within the same root (Move has no confirm).
pathParts/samePath/withinPath are duplicated verbatim in useExplorerOps.ts and (pathParts/withinPath) in src/state/useEditor.ts.
explorerResetKey is now `${view}|${selectedAppId}|${explorer.root}` (activePath removed) so a renamed tab under the same root keeps the tree.
r9_delete_uses_the_real_recycle_bin (now :302) lists and restores the item via trash::os_limited, so QA-1 is fixed; cargo test --test explorer_ops 17/17 pass.
still only exercises AppDef::executable_terminals(); no test calls commands::start_all/stop_all, so QA-2 stays open.

Tauri State cannot be built outside the app runtime, so R11 command-level tests drive commands::start_all_in/stop_all_in (the exact loops start_all/stop_all delegate to); commands/config/runtime are pub and the *_in fns are pub for this.

rename_and_repath/move_and_repath now undo the fs rename when Store::repath_prefix fails; delete_and_close_with snapshots entries, closes tabs first, and restores them if the Recycle Bin refuses (REV-1 fixed).
Store::commit replaces entries then restores them if persist fails; repath_prefix/close_prefix both go through it, so a failed save never leaves the store half-changed.
useExplorerOps takes an optional onCommitted fired only after a successful rename/move/delete (not create/refused); ExplorerPanel passes clearSelection (REV-2 fixed).
`selected` is cleared by onCommitted after rename/move/delete, so the toolbar's Rename/Move/Delete fall back to disabled instead of acting on a stale path.
explorerResetKey is `${view}|${selectedAppId}|${explorer.root}` (activePath removed) so a renamed tab under the same root keeps the tree.

tab state is local useState("projects") at 64; filesMounted lazy mount at 67; expandOnto (rail) at 75-78; topRow strip then Projects panel then Files panel at 115-139; no tab state or handlers in App.tsx.

renders role=tablist/tab with aria-selected and roving tabindex (active 0), ArrowLeft/Right onChange then focus in rAF; no tabpanel and no aria-controls (103-126).

R2 proof is containment outside the panel (163-174) plus CSS string checks (204-216); 1 vs 50 apps position is never compared and DOM order is never asserted.

showFiles() (125-129) waits only for the Files region; several callers then getByTitle immediately (242, 262, 283, 319, 563, 567, 591, 594, 809, 812) and race the async listing; rename/delete/image failed under doubled CPU load.
